title: Exhibit a field-uniform three-block signature missed by every generic support
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. This answers Open next question 1 of SHIN09-git's #6708: cancellation can produce a three-block, two-ports-per-block signature absent from every generic support pattern.

```text
Six source masks: ABC, ABC, ABC, ABC, ABC, ABC
Special reader masks: BC, BC, AC, AC, AB, AB
Generic full-reader floor: at least 3; special witness: 0
```

The integer basis and inverse are unimodular, with entries in {0,1,-1}, so the same signature works over every field, including F2. The new generic theorem is sharp: on b >= 2 nonempty blocks, full source masks force at least b full reader masks. A determinant-matching graph and a source strongly connected component prove the exclusion for every support, not just this witness's support.

Only `research/three-block-cancellation-signature/` is added. The new proof, construction and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit SHIN09-git #6708 for the question and two-block classification, Gonzalo Mier #3990/#3997 and Nick Petalas #6691 for the preceding source/reader model and screens. Structural determinant/cofactor matchings and the inverse-path description are classical. The predecessor's scientific verifier is not imported or replayed.

## Evidence

Before: the cited package leaves three-block cancellation outside the generic census open. After: an explicit six-port integer inverse pair and a universal generic exclusion settle that question.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only:

- Both integer inverse products and separate rational elimination pass. The signature is checked over F2, F3, F5, F7 and F11.
- All 59,131 full-source supports on (1,1,1), (2,1,1), (2,2,1) are enumerated. The 58,081 structurally invertible supports pass separate cofactor-matching and graph-reachability checks. Two six-port patterns check sharpness and specialization.
- All 27 nonzero-entry omissions and five invalid-input controls are rejected.
- Both registered commands pass and produce identical generated receipts in direct normal/optimized runs. Direct times were 1.60 s and 1.47 s; registered replay took 3.33 s total. Every check is below its 120 s timeout.
- Metadata/source pins, committed bytes/modes, source-history ancestry and whitespace checks pass. The selected source-binding orientation passes; no selected scientific suite is replayed.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/three-block-cancellation-signature
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/three-block-cancellation-signature/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/three-block-cancellation-signature/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/three-block-cancellation-signature --check-source-history --check-modes
```

A different CPython 3.12 path may replace the local path. Expected markers are `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_THREE_BLOCK_CANCELLATION_SIGNATURE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations

The all-field witness and all-size generic bound use the written proof; the checks are finite corroborations, not an exhaustive six-port census. No complete three-block classification, physical decoder price, native schedule, supplier admission, new kappa or multiplication theorem is claimed. Preparation, delivery, dirty restoration, routing, precision, stock, compiler closure and the full signed invoice remain obligations. No Lean, Docker, independent human or formal proof-kernel review is claimed. The selected #7000 record and its five assumptions are unchanged.

## Open next questions

1. Classify further three-block signatures absent from the generic census. Start with inverse bases having zero diagonal blocks.
2. Test whether a complete physical source/reader schedule for these matrices wins after every preparation, delivery and restoration charge. No favorable invoice is supplied here.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this three-block square-basis signature quantity was found in the live title/body and claim checks. Merged #6708 is the direct predecessor. #7053's three internal paired-star blocks are a different object and quantity.

[Advance claim and scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19538530). Canonical main was refreshed before publication at `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; priority revision 8. Explicit main-tree and merged-PR searches supplement the sparse working-note overlap inventory; arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.
